title: Champions League top scorers, 1992/93 to 2001/02
brief: Name the top scorer in each Champions League season. For shared awards, any of the joint top scorers counts.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2001/02, group stage onwards (in 1992/93 and 1993/94 the first and second rounds count, as UEFA counts them)

rows.name: Wynton Rufer
rows.val: 8 goals each, Werder Bremen and Barcelona

rows.name: Andriy Shevchenko
rows.val: 8 goals each, Dynamo Kyiv and Man Utd

rows.name: Raul
rows.val: 10 goals each, Real Madrid, Barcelona and Porto

notes.Filippo Inzaghi: Filippo Inzaghi never finished a season as the top scorer.
notes.Thierry Henry: Thierry Henry never finished a season as the top scorer.

checks: Every season checked against UEFA.com season stats, the Transfermarkt season scorer list and the Wikipedia list of season top scorers; all three agree except 1993/94, where Wikipedia and Transfermarkt have Koeman level with Rufer on 8 and UEFA.com has Koeman on 7, so either name fills that slot. Shared awards are one slot with alts.
